Access available November 15 - April 15. ids = the combined 'Dolomiti Superski' row, the rows named after those zones, and component rows tied to a zone by a fetched Wikipedia page (Belvedere-Col Rodella, Buffaure-Ciampac, Vigo di Fassa-Ciampedie, Latemar/Obereggen, Alpe Cermis, Plose, Padola, Lagazuoi) or by locality (Cortina Tofane, Cristallo-Faloria). destinations.name: Valle d’Aosta
destinations.note: 7 days total at Cervino Ski Paradise, Courmayeur Mont Blanc, La Thuile - Espace San Bernardo, Monterosa Ski, Pila. Access available Nov. 1, 2026 - May 31, 2027. The Cervinia side exists in the index only as the cross-border row 'Zermatt - Breuil-Cervinia' (also listed under Zermatt Matterhorn) plus 'Valtournenche'. Left out, not confirmed by a fetched page: La Rosière (French side of Espace San Bernardo), the Monterosa satellite areas (Antagnod, Brusson, Gressoney-Saint-Jean, Champorcher), Torgnon, Chamois.

destinations.name: Zermatt Matterhorn

The index has one combined cross-border row, which is also listed under Valle d'Aosta for its Cervinia side.
